note.he: מכניס/ה am / is / are לפני פועל רגיל (I am go)
note.en: Puts am / is / are before a base verb (I am go)

tip.he: בעברית "אני הולך/ת" זו מילה אחת. באנגלית: I go, או I am going. אין I am go.
tip.en: Say I go or I am going. Never I am go.

note.he: משתמש/ת ב־ing להרגלים ועובדות קבועות
note.en: Uses -ing for habits and permanent facts

tip.he: הרגל או עובדה (every day, usually, always) = Present Simple: She drinks coffee every morning.
tip.en: Habits and facts (every day, usually) use the Present Simple: She drinks coffee every morning.

note.he: מוסיף/ה s לפועל אחרי does / doesn't
note.en: Adds -s to the verb after does / doesn't

tip.he: ה־s כבר נמצאת ב־does. אחריו בא פועל בסיס: Does she like? She doesn't like.
tip.en: The -s is already in does. Use the base verb after it: Does she like? She doesn't like.

note.he: שואל/ת שאלה בלי do / does (Where you live?)
note.en: Asks a question without do / does (Where you live?)

tip.he: בעברית שואלים בטון. באנגלית צריך פועל עזר: Where do you live?
tip.en: Hebrew asks with intonation. English needs a helping verb: Where do you live?

note.he: משתמש/ת בהווה פשוט לפעולה שקורית עכשיו (כמו בעברית)
note.en: Uses the Present Simple for an action happening now (as in Hebrew)

tip.he: בעברית יש הווה אחד. באנגלית, מה שקורה עכשיו: am / is / are + ing. Look! It is raining.
tip.en: Hebrew has one present. In English, for now use am / is / are + -ing: Look! It is raining.

note.he: שוכח/ת am / is / are לפני ing (She cooking)
note.en: Leaves out am / is / are before -ing (She cooking)

tip.he: בהווה מתמשך צריך שני חלקים: is + cooking. She is cooking.
tip.en: The Present Progressive needs two parts: is + cooking. She is cooking.

note.he: מוסיף/ה ing לפעלי מצב (I am knowing)
note.en: Adds -ing to state verbs (I am knowing)

tip.he: know, like, want, understand, belong הם פעלי מצב. אומרים I know, גם כשמדובר בעכשיו.
tip.en: know, like, want, understand and belong are state verbs. Say I know, even about now.

note.he: טועה בכתיב של ing (writeing, swiming)
note.en: Misspells -ing forms (writeing, swiming)

tip.he: e שקטה נופלת: write → writing. עיצור + תנועה קצרה + עיצור: מכפילים: swim → swimming.
tip.en: Drop a silent e: writing. Double the last consonant after a short vowel: swimming.

note.he: טועה בכתיב של ed (stoped, studyed)
note.en: Misspells -ed forms (stoped, studyed)

tip.he: stop → stopped (מכפילים). study → studied (y הופך ל־i). play → played (תנועה לפני y).
tip.en: stop → stopped (double). study → studied (y to i). play → played (vowel before y).

note.he: משתמש/ת ב־was / were עם פועל בסיס (I wasn't go, Were you eat?)
note.en: Uses was / were with a base verb (I wasn't go, Were you eat?)

tip.he: עם פועל רגיל בעבר משתמשים ב־did: Did you eat? I didn't go. was / were באים עם שם תואר, מקום או ing.
tip.en: With a normal verb in the past use did: Did you eat? I didn't go.

note.he: שואל/ת שאלה בעבר בלי did (What you ate?)
note.en: Asks a past question without did (What you ate?)

tip.he: שאלה בעבר: מילת שאלה + did + נושא + פועל בסיס. What did you eat?
tip.en: Past question: question word + did + subject + base verb. What did you eat?

note.he: בונה עבר מתמשך בלי was / were או בלי ing
note.en: Builds the Past Progressive without was / were or without -ing

tip.he: עבר מתמשך = was / were + ing. I was walking. They were playing.
tip.en: Past Progressive = was / were + -ing. I was walking. They were playing.

note.he: משתמש/ת ב־during לפני משפט (during I was...)
note.en: Uses during before a clause (during I was...)

tip.he: while + נושא ופועל: while I was sleeping. during + שם עצם: during the night.
tip.en: while + subject and verb: while I was sleeping. during + noun: during the night.

note.he: משתמש/ת בעבר מתמשך לפעולה קצרה ופתאומית
note.en: Uses the Past Progressive for a short, sudden action

tip.he: הפעולה הארוכה: was + ing. הפעולה הקצרה שקטעה: Past Simple. I was skiing when I broke my leg.
tip.en: Long action: was + -ing. The short action: Past Simple. I was skiing when I broke my leg.

note.he: טועה בצורה של used to (I use to, didn't used to)
note.en: Gets the form of used to wrong (I use to, didn't used to)

tip.he: במשפט חיובי: used to. אחרי did / didn't: use to. I used to swim. I didn't use to swim.
tip.en: Positive: used to. After did / didn't: use to.

note.he: מבלבל/ת בין used to (הרגל בעבר) ל־be used to (רגיל ל)
note.en: Confuses used to (past habit) with be used to (accustomed to)

tip.he: used to + פועל בסיס = פעם נהגתי. be used to + ing = אני רגיל/ה ל. I used to swim. I am used to swimming.
tip.en: used to + base verb = past habit. be used to + -ing = accustomed to.

note.he: משתמש/ת ב־will אחרי when / as soon as / until (כמו בעברית)
note.en: Uses will after when / as soon as / until (as in Hebrew)

tip.he: בעברית "כשאגיע" בעתיד. באנגלית אחרי מילות זמן: הווה פשוט. I'll call you when I get home.
tip.en: Hebrew uses the future here. English uses the Present Simple after time words: when I get home.

note.he: בונה going to בלי be, בלי to, או בלי פועל בסיס
note.en: Builds going to without be, without to, or without a base verb

tip.he: המבנה המלא: am / is / are + going to + פועל בסיס. It is going to rain.
tip.en: The full form: am / is / are + going to + base verb. It is going to rain.

note.he: מבלבל/ת בין yet ל־already
note.en: Confuses yet and already

tip.he: already במשפט חיובי (I have already eaten). yet בשלילה ובשאלה, בסוף המשפט (I haven't eaten yet).
tip.en: already in positive sentences. yet in negatives and questions, at the end.

note.he: מבלבל/ת בין has been to ל־has gone to
note.en: Confuses has been to and has gone to

tip.he: has been to = ביקר וחזר. has gone to = נסע ועדיין שם.
tip.en: has been to = visited and came back. has gone to = went and is still there.

note.he: משתמש/ת ב־Past Simple לתקופה שעוד לא נגמרה (since, so far, still)
note.en: Uses the Past Simple for a period that is not over (since, so far, still)

tip.he: since, so far, still מראים שהתקופה נמשכת עד עכשיו, ולכן Present Perfect: I haven't seen him since May.
tip.en: since, so far and still show the period continues, so use the Present Perfect.

note.he: משתמש/ת בהווה לפעולה שנמשכת עד עכשיו ("אני מחכה כבר שעה")
note.en: Uses the present for an action lasting until now (as in Hebrew)

tip.he: בעברית "אני מחכה כבר שעה". באנגלית: I have been waiting for an hour.
tip.en: Hebrew uses the present. English: I have been waiting for an hour.

note.he: משתמש/ת ב־have been + ing כשסופרים דברים שהסתיימו
note.en: Uses have been + -ing when counting finished things

tip.he: כמות שהסתיימה = Present Perfect: I have written three emails. התהליך = have been writing.
tip.en: A finished amount = Present Perfect: I have written three emails. The activity = have been writing.

note.he: לא משתמש/ת ב־Past Perfect לפעולה שקרתה לפני פעולה אחרת בעבר
note.en: Does not use the Past Perfect for an action before another past action

tip.he: שתי פעולות בעבר: המוקדמת יותר = had + צורה שלישית. When I arrived, he had left.
tip.en: Two past actions: the earlier one = had + past participle. When I arrived, he had left.

note.he: משתמש/ת בצורת עבר אחרי had (had went, had saw)
note.en: Uses the past form after had (had went, had saw)

tip.he: אחרי had באה הצורה השלישית: had gone, had seen, had eaten.
tip.en: After had use the third form: had gone, had seen, had eaten.

note.he: משתמש/ת ב־have / has בסיפור על העבר במקום had
note.en: Uses have / has instead of had in a past story

tip.he: כשהסיפור כולו בעבר, have / has הופכים ל־had: I knew the ending because I had seen the movie.
tip.en: When the story is in the past, have / has becomes had.

note.he: משתמש/ת בפעיל כשהנושא מקבל את הפעולה (English speaks)
note.en: Uses the active form when the subject receives the action (English speaks)

tip.he: לשאול: הנושא עושה או שעושים לו? אם עושים לו: be + צורה שלישית. English is spoken.
tip.en: Ask: does the subject act, or is it acted on? If acted on: be + past participle.

note.he: משתמש/ת ב־from במקום by בסביל
note.en: Uses from instead of by in the passive

tip.he: מי שעשה את הפעולה בא אחרי by: written by, painted by.
tip.en: The doer comes after by: written by, painted by.

note.he: בוחר/ת זמן לא נכון ל־be בסביל
note.en: Uses the wrong tense of be in the passive

tip.he: הזמן נמצא ב־be: is made (הווה), was made (עבר), is being made (עכשיו), has been made.
tip.en: The tense is in be: is made, was made, is being made, has been made.
